content: Dhruv Kapoor called to discuss his auto policy that expired on March 8th. Sunita Agarwal explained that reinstating the policy would incur a $50 fee and a 10% premium penalty, and offered to provide new insurance quotes. She checked several alternative options and presented them for Dhruv to consider.

action_items: Agent to provide detailed quotes for new auto insurance options
Customer to review quotes and decide on reinstatement or a new policy
